name: data-grid-server-query
title: Data Grid Server Query
author: gridcn
description: The server half of a server-driven gridcn grid: a column map that is the allow-list and the projection, parseQuery that turns an untrusted grid request into a bounded, typed query plan (escaping, null and blank rules, number and day bounds, limits), handleGridRequest for a route handler, and describeFilterOperators so the filter UI offers only what the server accepts. Add an ORM adapter to run the plan.
